blocks.text: Alkyl halides do mukhtalif tareeqon se nucleophilic substitution reactions karte hain:

Alkyl halides ke nucleophilic substitution mein do bare kaam hote hain: leaving group ka nikalna (C – X bond ka tootna) aur nucleophile ka hamla (C – Nu bond ka banna). Agar dono kaam ek hi qadam (step) mein saath saath hon to mechanism (reaction ka tareeqa-e-amal) SN2 kehlata hai. Agar dono alag alag qadmon mein hon, yani pehle qadam mein bond toote aur doosre qadam mein naya bond bane, to mechanism SN1 kehlata hai.
i) Nucleophilic Substitution Bimolecular (SN2)

Yeh ek qadam (single step) wala mechanism hai. Jaise hi nucleophile substrate (jis molecule par reaction ho raha hai) ke electrophilic carbon par hamla shuru karta hai, leaving group wala bond tootna shuru ho jata hai. Yani jitna naya bond banta hai, utna hi purana bond toot'ta hai.

Is mechanism ki doosri ahem baat hamle ki simt (direction) hai. Nucleophile leaving group ki ulti (opposite) taraf se hamla karta hai. Nucleophile ka hamla aur leaving group ka nikalna, sab kuch ek hi waqt mein hota hai.

blocks.alt: OH- se bromomethane ke delta+ carbon ki taraf mura teer, Br ki mukhalif simt se hamla, aur C-Br bond se Br ki taraf mura teer. Phir bracket mein transition state HO---C---Br, manfi charge ke saath; phir methanol jis ke teen H doosri taraf palat gaye (O par delta-, C par delta+) + Br-.
blocks.caption: SN2 mechanism: bromomethane aur hydroxide ion (kitab ke PDF safha 79 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke SN2 khaake mein C–Br bond ke electrons ka Br ki taraf jane wala mura teer (curly arrow) nahi chhapa. Br apne bond ke electrons le kar nikalta hai, is liye hamare khaake mein yeh teer shamil kiya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: OH⁻ carbon par Br ki ulti taraf (peeche) se hamla karta hai. Ek hi qadam mein naya C–OH bond banta hai aur C–Br bond toot'ta hai; bracket wali transition state (darmiyani halat) mein dono bond aadhe bane aur aadhe toote hote hain. Product mein teeno H doosri taraf palat jate hain, jaise tez hawa mein chhatri ulat jati hai (inversion).

Is mechanism mein reaction sirf ek qadam mein hota hai, wahi rate-determining step (reaction ki raftaar tay karne wala qadam) hai, aur is qadam mein do molecules hissa lete hain. Is liye yeh bimolecular (do molecules wala) reaction hai.

Kinetic studies (raftaar ki tehqeeq) se pata chala hai ke SN2 reactions ki raftaar (rate) alkyl halide aur hamla karne wale nucleophile, dono ki concentrations (miqdar fi hajam) par munhasir hai. Hisaab ki zuban mein:
Aam SN2 reaction second order reaction hai.

Monohalogenoalkanes mein se primary monohalogenoalkanes par jab nucleophile hamla karta hai to woh hamesha SN2 mechanism se chalte hain. Wajah steric (jagah ki tangi se mutaliq) hai: primary mein substrate carbon par hydrogen atoms ya sirf ek carbon jura hota hai, is liye nucleophile aasani se electrophilic carbon tak pohanch kar hamla kar leta hai.
ii) Nucleophilic Substitution Unimolecular (SN1)

Is mechanism ke do qadam hain. Pehle qadam mein alkyl halide aabi (aqueous) acetone ya aabi ethyl alcohol mein ionize hota hai (ions mein toot'ta hai); yeh qadam reversible (ulta bhi chal sakne wala) hai. Is qadam se carbocation (musbat charge wala carbon) intermediate (darmiyani cheez) ke taur par banta hai. Doosre qadam mein nucleophile is carbocation par hamla kar ke product banata hai.

blocks.alt: Pehla qadam: (H3C)3C-Br, C par delta+ aur Br par delta-, equilibrium teeron (slow) se satah wala (planar) carbocation + Br- deta hai. Doosra qadam: carbocation + OH-, OH- se musbat carbon ki taraf mura teer, tez (fast), (H3C)3C-OH deta hai (Product).
blocks.caption: SN1 mechanism (kitab ke PDF safha 80 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle qadam mein do teer (⇌) hain kyun ke ionization reversible hai; yeh qadam sust (slow) hai aur rate tay karta hai. Carbocation ka musbat carbon satah wala (planar) hai, is liye OH⁻ kisi bhi taraf se hamla kar sakta hai. Doosra qadam tez (fast) hai.

Pehle qadam mein covalent bond toot'ta hai, is liye yeh doosre qadam ke muqable mein sust hai. Doosre qadam mein mukhalif charge wale ions mil jate hain, jo energy ke lihaz se aasan (favourable) hai. Is liye pehla qadam rate-determining step kehlata hai. Mechanism ko unimolecular is liye kehte hain ke rate-determining step mein sirf ek molecule hissa leta hai.
SN1 reactions first order kinetics dikhate hain aur in ki raftaar sirf alkyl halide ki concentration par munhasir hai. In ki rate equation yeh hai:

Tertiary monohalogenoalkanes par jab nucleophile hamla kare to woh hamesha SN1 mechanism se chalte hain. Bari wajah mustahkam (stable) tertiary carbocation ka banna hai. Is ke ilawa electrophilic carbon par lage teen bare (bulky) groups nucleophile ko leaving group ke peeche se hamla karne nahi dete. Is liye substrate molecule SN1 mechanism ko pasand karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar carbocations is tarteeb mein: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl. Har musbat carbon apne groups ke saath; CH3 groups ke bonds par laal teer carbon ki taraf. Tertiary par teen CH3, secondary par do, primary par aik aur methyl carbocation par koi nahi.
blocks.caption: Musbat inductive effect (+I) ke kam hone se carbocations ke istehkaam (stability) ki ghat'ti tarteeb (kitab ke PDF safha 80 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har CH₃ group apne electrons musbat carbon ki taraf dhakelta hai (laal teer, +I effect) aur us ka musbat charge kuch kam kar deta hai. Jitne zyada CH₃ groups, utna mustahkam carbocation: tertiary (3) > secondary (2) > primary (1) > methyl (0).

Mechanism batata hai ke rate-determining step mein carbocation banta hai; is liye carbocation jitna mustahkam ho, utni aasani se banta hai. Tertiary carbocations secondary se zyada mustahkam hain, aur secondary carbocations primary se zyada mustahkam hain.
Secondary halogenoalkane solvent (jis maaye mein reaction ho) ki qism ke mutabiq SN2 aur SN1 dono mechanisms se react kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tertiary halogenoalkanes SN1 se aur primary SN2 se kyun react karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Tertiary: teen alkyl groups carbocation ko mustahkam karte hain aur peeche se hamla rokte hain. Primary: carbocation kamzor (unstable) hota hai, lekin carbon ke gird bheer nahi hoti, is liye nucleophile ek qadam mein seedha hamla kar leta hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: SN2: ek qadam, peeche se hamla, Rate = k[Alkyl halide][Nucleophile], second order; primary halogenoalkanes.
SN1: pehle sust ionization se carbocation, phir tez hamla; Rate = k[Alkyl halide], first order; tertiary halogenoalkanes.
Carbocation ki mazbooti: tertiary > secondary > primary > methyl; secondary dono raste le sakta hai.
